title: DeployStored
description:
Contract `sites/deploy-stored.v1`: the answer of `POST /v1/sites/{site}/deploys`.

The bundle of `commit` is stored for the site and every file matched the manifest. Every other
member is refused.

commit.description: The commit of the bundle, which is the deploy id.

created.description:
`true` when this request stored the bundle; `false` when an earlier deploy of the same
commit was already stored and is returned unchanged.

file_count.description: The number of files of the bundle.

site_id.description: The site that the bundle is stored for.

size_bytes.description: The total length of the file bytes of the bundle, at most 2^53 - 1.

SiteId.title: SiteId
SiteId.description:
The id of one site: 3 to 40 lower-case ASCII letters, digits and `-`.

The grammar is the `site:<site id>` form of `WriteOrigin` in `ratatoskr-notes-contracts`.
The owner chooses the id, and it appears in every route under `/v1/sites/{site}/`.
